notes: Design check only. scientific_validity is not_assessed. uv run python -m unittest tests.test_r4_trees -q passed 2 tests with exit code 0. Those tests use NumPy seed 0 and sklearn random_state 0. Discovery and confirmation were left unrun, and seeds 5101, 5102, and 6101-6105 were left unfitted. The six protocol grids stay separate. tree_leaves varies max_leaf_nodes from 2 to 256 on one DecisionTreeRegressor. forest_size_restricted varies n_estimators over 1, 5, 10, 25, and 50 with max_leaf_nodes 8. forest_size_large uses that same estimator list with max_leaf_nodes 256. gbdt_steps, gbdt_depth, and gbdt_split_fraction vary n_estimators, max_depth, and max_features inside sklearn.ensemble.GradientBoostingRegressor. jobs_for takes the single list inside each grid and keeps the grid name on every cell. validate_protocol rejects equal forest leaf caps. PLAN.md and the protocol axis note leave L05-L07 unresolved. CatBoost is absent from the imports and from _fit. The library note states that limit, and the gbdt_split_fraction values are the sklearn feature fractions 0.25, 0.5, and 1.0. The axis note calls that separate grid a split-candidate count. The residual tolerance is the protocol constant 1e-8, and validate_protocol rejects any other value. n_jobs is 1, including the RandomForestRegressor constructor. gpu_jobs is 0. The task modules import neither torch nor a dataset fetcher. Rows come from src.controlled_synthetic, and OpenMP, MKL, and OpenBLAS are pinned to 4 threads. Discovery seeds 5101-5102 and confirmation seeds 6101-6105 are disjoint, as are evaluation seeds 50001/50002 and 60001/60002. The registered tasks are solver-checks and discovery. build_discovery fits the discovery phase on the full menu. reduce_menu uses discovery wall-clock, the discovery and confirmation draw counts, and safety factor 1.5, records used_clean_risk false, and keeps every grid point when the projected confirmation time is below 1800 seconds. Otherwise each grid keeps its first, middle, and last setting. freeze_grid rejects an export that carries clean_mse or a reduction whose used_clean_risk is anything other than false. contrast_margins is unused by that rule. Exit criteria C1-C5 and predictions P1-P3 allow a run with no peak. Task inputs list the local modules the tasks load: scripts/r4_run.py, src/__init__.py, src/r4_trees.py, src/controlled_synthetic.py, and, for solver-checks, tests/test_r4_trees.py, plus the protocol and PLAN. NumPy and scikit-learn come from the environment. This review leaves the plan unfrozen and leaves execution_authorized unset. reviewer_agent is UNSTATED.
